excerpt: graph : read recurrent states in place instead of copying (#28841) (#30139) graph : read recurrent states in place instead of copying (#28841) This is a graph only change that speeds up token output in the majority of cases and backends by removing state copy steps. Where possible, kernels now read recurrent states directly from the cache instead of a copy from ggml_get_rows. A change to RWKV6/7 makes it read its old state before overwriting. A graph-reuse check condition is added to keep track of whether states are read in place.
